subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should maintainers treat the remaining work as a core Telegram/provider-concurrency bug needing live current-main reproduction, or close it as sufficiently mitigated by the terminal-abort/fallback fixes?
rationale: Current source shows partial mitigations and one remaining source-level concurrency coupling, but the proposed fixes touch fallback semantics, launch environment defaults, and possible config surfaces that need owner intent before implementation.

options.title: Keep open for live core repro
